CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `export_templates_enhanced` (
  `id` int AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
  `user_id` int NOT NULL,
  `name` varchar(100) NOT NULL,
  `description` text,
  `template_type` enum('error_book', 'review_card', 'exam_paper', 'analysis_report', 'custom') DEFAULT 'custom' NOT NULL,
  `is_default` boolean DEFAULT false NOT NULL,
  `is_public` boolean DEFAULT false NOT NULL,
  `is_system_preset` boolean DEFAULT false NOT NULL,
  `filter_config` json,
  `sort_config` json,
  `content_config` json,
  `style_config` json,
  `export_format` enum('pdf', 'word', 'markdown', 'html') DEFAULT 'pdf' NOT NULL,
  `usage_count` int DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  `last_used_at` timestamp,
  `created_at` timestamp DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL,
  `updated_at` timestamp DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL,
  INDEX `user_id_idx` (`user_id`),
  INDEX `is_public_idx` (`is_public`),
  INDEX `template_type_idx` (`template_type`),
  INDEX `is_default_idx` (`is_default`)
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `quick_export_configs` (
  `id` int AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
  `user_id` int NOT NULL,
  `template_id` int NOT NULL,
  `name` varchar(100) NOT NULL,
  `shortcut_key` varchar(20),
  `display_order` int DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  `show_in_toolbar` boolean DEFAULT true NOT NULL,
  `icon` varchar(50),
  `usage_count` int DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  `last_used_at` timestamp,
  `created_at` timestamp DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL,
  `updated_at` timestamp DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL,
  INDEX `user_id_idx` (`user_id`),
  INDEX `template_id_idx` (`template_id`)
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `export_history_records` (
  `id` int AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
  `user_id` int NOT NULL,
  `template_id` int,
  `export_type` enum('error_questions', 'exam_paper', 'learning_report', 'custom') NOT NULL,
  `export_format` enum('pdf', 'word', 'markdown', 'html') NOT NULL,
  `question_count` int DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  `file_url` varchar(500),
  `file_key` varchar(500),
  `file_size` int,
  `config_snapshot` json,
  `status` enum('pending', 'processing', 'completed', 'failed') DEFAULT 'pending' NOT NULL,
  `error_message` text,
  `processing_time_ms` int,
  `created_at` timestamp DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL,
  INDEX `user_id_idx` (`user_id`),
  INDEX `template_id_idx` (`template_id`),
  INDEX `status_idx` (`status`),
  INDEX `created_at_idx` (`created_at`)
);
